verdict.rationale: Graphite describes its AI reviewer as a "codebase-aware AI code review agent" (graphite-docs-16), and Graphite Chat can "find related files, understand dependencies, and get context from other PRs" (graphite-docs-15). Conventions can be encoded by hand through custom rules (graphite-docs-5), but the evidence never shows that automatic review comments actually draw on call sites, related modules, or inferred conventions beyond the diff. Missing for 10: documentation of how review comments use repository-wide context (call sites, cross-module impact), automatic learning of existing conventions without manual rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration of whole-repo-aware review comments.
